title: 인천광역시 미추홀구와 연수구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:35494:20250507:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 미추홀구와 연수구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 35494, May 7, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on the date 30 days have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.)
(1) Public notices, dispositions, and other acts taken before this Decree enters into force by the head of a former local government or the head of an agency under that head in relation to an area incorporated into another local government shall be deemed to have been taken by the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over that area under this Decree or the head of an agency under that head.
(2) Applications, reports, and other acts made before this Decree enters into force to the head of a former local government or the head of an agency under that head shall be deemed to have been made to the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over the area incorporated into another local government under this Decree or the head of an agency under that head.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes) Until a statute that, as of the enforcement of this Decree, defines all or part of an autonomous district area changed under this Decree as its area or jurisdictional area is amended to reflect the changes made by this Decree, the statutes concerned shall apply by deeming the changed autonomous district area to belong to the area or jurisdictional area of the autonomous district to which it belonged before the change.
